pages.text: Different bees make combs of different things, from honey to diamonds.

Solitary bees live in nests out in the world. They won't live in a hive and make nothing themselves; they're for breeding. Set a nest in the right biome and feed it Honey Treats, and a new bee moves in.

Productive bees live in an Advanced Beehive, and a Centrifuge spins their combs apart. Most come from breeding, and the Big Book of Bees knows every pairing. If a bee won't settle, check its flowers and the weather.
